ice.why: The team lead (2026-11-15 11:28/11:36 CET): glacial ice is not an analog of regolith. snow_ice_frac = ESA CCI land-cover class 220 (permanent snow and ice) share of the cell's land pixels (real_data/provenance_earth.csv).

water.why: Same reasoning as the ice rule (a cell that is mostly sea or lake is not solid ground); mask_fraction = land share of the cell (ESA CCI land cover, inland water counts as water). Found by the first implementer: the Rover number 1, E3872 on the Kara Sea coast, is 33.8 % land. Separately switchable, TO BE CONFIRMED by the team lead.

bundle_mission_top5.rule: 241 sites (cells less than half ice and at least half land) tie at the top score: their difference in slope and roughness from their lunar twin is within the measurement error of the elevation models, so the data cannot tell them apart. The five shown are chosen among those tied sites (without cells that are half or more ice or less than half land) to be as far apart as possible: the first is the tied site with the highest similarity, then each next one is the tied site farthest from those already chosen. The full ranking itself is unchanged.

alternative.rule: The five shown are chosen down the full ranking by final score: a point whose cell is half or more snow and ice, or less than half land, is skipped, and so is a point within 2 degrees of arc (about 222.4 km) of one already kept. The full ranking itself is unchanged.
